results.summary_before: tcpu is an 8-bit CPU with integrated IO and a bootloader, featuring a simple instruction set that includes add, and, not, jump, store, load, and nop operations. It uses a UART interface for programming and communication, requiring an external USB-to-UART converter. The CPU is designed for educational purposes and can be tested on a Tiny Tapeout board. Its notable feature is the integrated bootloader for easy program loading.
results.summary: This project is an 8-bit arithmetic logic unit that performs arithmetic and bitwise operations on integer binary numbers. It uses a state machine to read two 8-bit operands from the input pins and to control the operation. The ALU outputs the result and status flags, including carry/borrow, through the output pins. Testing involves setting the state to read operands, selecting an operation, calculating, and then displaying the status.

results.summary_before: This project implements an error-correction encoder that loads a 6-bit input and shifts it out while encoding the bits for transmission. The write_not_shift control selects between loading and shifting, and the encoded bits are shown one at a time on an 8-segment display. It is tested using the standard Tiny Tapeout board with DIP switches and a display. The design demonstrates error-correction encoding and shift register operation.
results.summary: This project sets a railway signal based on track information. It takes inputs such as track free status, pre-signal, allow shunting, and shorter braking distance. The outputs control various signal lamps including green, orange, red, yellow, and white indicators. The design simply switches lamps on and off based on the input toggles.
